messages.snippet: Gordon, Lesley, Thank you for your call on Friday. As discussed, we are happy to act for Sutherland
messages.subject: Project Northwind — engagement and next steps
messages.plaintextBody:
Gordon, Lesley,

Thank you for your call on Friday. As discussed, we are happy to act for Sutherland Logistics on the proposed restructuring of the Sterling facilities. I attach our engagement letter setting out scope and fees — please sign and return the duplicate, and we will arrange the £25,000 payment on account.

Immediate priorities: (1) get the independent business review under way with Marlow; (2) review the Bank's reservation of rights letter; and (3) open a dialogue with Gavin Ross's team on a standstill while we document a deal. We have capacity to move quickly.

Elena will send through our standard information request today.

Best regards,
Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0500

messages.snippet: Sarah, Understood and agreed — signed copy to follow tomorrow and the payment on account will go out
messages.subject: RE: Project Northwind — engagement and next steps
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Understood and agreed — signed copy to follow tomorrow and the payment on account will go out this week. Gordon and I would like to keep this very tight; the December covenant test has clearly spooked Sterling and we cannot afford a misstep.

Please push hard on the standstill. Cash is the constraint and we have a pinch point in late April.

Lesley
Finance Director, Sutherland Logistics Limited
